text_block_list.text:
November ▲ | Noon | Wind: Piercing Gale 
"It's Not Over Yet" ====================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Taking Katsuragi Ace's advice, we kept 
running even after pushing past our 
limits. And that's how our running style 
was perfected!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Having finally reached the Japan Cup, the 
strongest Symboli stands in the way. But 
today, merely crushing him won't be 
enough!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
If I can't put on a performance that blows 
the whole world away for my benefactor, 
I'll never be able to reach that treasure 
called 'eternal smiles' that I'm chasing 
after!
